name: sac-platform
description: S.A.C. — root convenience scripts. The real packages are app/ and functions/.

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix app run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.setup: npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm --prefix app run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project sac-rules-test "npm --prefix tests run test"
